description: The source describes shallow-well jet pumps for farm water-pressure systems, including an electric motor, impeller and jet assembly. It identifies a practical total pumping lift below 5.5 m (18 ft) and explains the jet assembly’s effect on discharge pressure and suction. These are source-described properties of water-supply equipment, not measured pump curves. Metadata lists PDF editions from 2000 and 2005 and an EPUB form of the 2005 publication. A specific hydraulic simulation application, tested performance range and pump-model identity are not stated. The editions are retained as one equipment information source; differences between their contents remain unverified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue provides descriptive metadata and exact original Alberta distribution identifiers. It labels the collection Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is through the linked descriptive record; current provider access and actual file downloads are untested. Costs are not stated. No document, workbook, archive or dataset body was fetched, and numerical contents have not been independently checked. Related editions and components are grouped only where the source identifies their relationship.
